source_metadata.title: Infectious Diseases Society of America 2026 Guidance on the Treatment of Antimicrobial-Resistant Gram-Negative Infections
source_metadata.source_type: clinical guidance document / secondary evidence synthesis
source_metadata.content_scope: Section 5 CRAB content beginning at the Section 5 heading on PDF page 52 through the content visible on PDF page 59; preceding DTR P. aeruginosa text on page 52 was excluded.
source_metadata.publication_id_consistency_note: This batch uses the publication_id from ciag481-general-v1 and the later pages22-29 batch. A prior ciag481-esbl-v1 pages10-21 output used a different publication_id and should be normalized before whole-document merge.

included: CRAB background beginning at the Section 5 heading on PDF page 52.
Questions 5.1 through 5.5 and their rationale content present on pages 53-59.
Question 5.6 suggested approach and only the complete rationale assertions visible on page 59.
excluded: The DTR P. aeruginosa text preceding the Section 5 heading on page 52.
No content before PDF page 52 or after PDF page 59 was used to create atoms, apart from publication metadata and prior batch identifiers needed for source identity/merge consistency.
Question 5.6 rationale continues onto page 60; no page-60 content was inspected or used for extraction.
Reference-list bibliographic details and supplemental material were not parsed.

extraction_limitations: The governing LiteratureAtom MVP is designed for primary literature, whereas ciag481.pdf is an IDSA clinical guidance document that synthesizes multiple underlying studies. Guideline recommendations were mapped to atom_kind=author_conclusion because the schema has no guideline_recommendation atom kind.

Quantitative and qualitative findings from cited trials, surveillance studies, PK/PD studies, animal models, systematic reviews, and meta-analyses are atoms of what the guidance reports, not direct re-extractions from the cited primary sources; these are tagged secondary_evidence_summary where applicable.

The schema provides a single quantitative_result.estimate field. For multi-arm results, estimate stores the first reported arm proportion while arm-specific event counts and denominators are preserved in quantitative_result.arms; no comparative effect measure was invented.

For the reported 20-25% nausea incidence and 27-57% colistin survival range, quantitative_result.estimate stores the reported lower bound and original_result_text preserves the full range; those atoms are explicitly tagged reported_range_lower_bound.

The guidance contains an internal denominator inconsistency on page 56: it describes a cefiderocol trial subgroup as n=54 while the reported arm denominators are 39 and 17 (sum 56). The quantitative atom preserves the arm counts and is accompanied by a limitation atom flagging the inconsistency.
Question 5.6 is truncated by the requested page boundary; only complete assertions on page 59 were extracted, and no continuation on page 60 was inferred.

All atoms are marked needs_review because extraction was performed by a language model and has not been independently human-verified. Structural, JSON Schema, and sufficiency validation do not establish source-fidelity verification.

A prior pages10-21 ESBL batch used a different publication_id from the general and later pages22-29 batches. This CRAB batch follows the general/later-batch publication_id (0b3d5893-0af1-52d1-b0e4-ca56f10ea325); a future merge should reconcile the ESBL publication_id conflict.
